# RUCKUS

> A browser party arena of four multiplayer games (Chickenz, 8-Ball, Egg Soccer, Neon Dash), built for Chain Jam Vol. 1. Play is free. Each game has one casino round, settled by a single ICasinoGameV2 contract using Chain's VRF, with a declared RTP of 96% on all 24 bet types. Live at https://playruckus.xyz.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): what it is, how it fits together, the wagers, jam requirements mapped to files, how to run and verify.
- [Architecture image](docs/assets/readme/architecture.png): browser, Colyseus game server, Convex, shared deterministic sims, wager path.

## Casino (jam eligibility)
- [RuckusGame.sol](contracts/src/RuckusGame.sol): ICasinoGameV2; drawClass (uint256 rejection sampling); one _payout() for quoteCaps, quoteRiskParams, onSessionStart, onRandomness.
- [Contract tests](contracts/test): RuckusGame.t.sol, Parity.t.sol (Solidity vs TypeScript payout vectors).
- [Payout tables, TS mirror](packages/casino-math/src/tables.ts): bet types 0-23, DECLARED_RTP_BPS = 9600.
- [Casino math tests](packages/casino-math/test): RTP per bet type, unbiased draw, parity vectors.
- [Seed banks](packages/casino-math/seedbanks): per-class seeds the client replays to present a VRF outcome; each sim's test replays every entry.
- [Casino bridge](packages/casino-bridge/src/bridge.ts): SDK-only host communication; standalone DemoHost ("Demo credits, no value") when there is no parent frame or no handshake within 3 s.
- [Manifest](apps/web/public/game.manifest.json): gameId "ruckus", served same-origin.

## Games
- [Web app](apps/web/src): hub and the four games (apps/web/src/games/<game>; games never import each other).
- [Chickenz sim](crates/chickenz-sim): Rust fixed-point, 4-player FFA, wasm build in packages/sim-chickenz.
- [Pool sim](packages/sim-pool), [Soccer sim](packages/sim-soccer), [Runner sim](packages/sim-runner): deterministic TypeScript, no clocks or Math.random, bots on the sim PRNG.
- [Game server rooms](apps/server/src/rooms): Colyseus rooms per game, authoritative sims, bots and watchers.
